verdict.rationale: fido2-manage is an official open-source Token2 tool that supports PIN set/change, resident-credential (passkey) and biometric slot management, and device info viewing, and a probe confirms it is documented as a CLI, giving genuine scriptable control over FIDO2 keys. However most docs describe it primarily as a Python/tkinter GUI rather than a dedicated CLI, and there's no explicit mention of an 'enable applications' feature or comprehensive CLI usage examples/API reference. missing for 10: explicit CLI command reference/examples, 'enable applications' capability, independent hands-on CLI scripting confirmation.
